sections.advice: Nan → Pua is 59 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Pua → Doi Phu Kha climbs about 1715 m in 22 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Doi Phu Kha → Bo Kluea drops about 1715 m over 11 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Bo Kluea → Santikhiri road is 26 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Santikhiri road → Nan is 46 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Nan Bo Kluea Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1715 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Nan Bo Kluea Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: For 21 km this is Nan Bo Kluea Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

nan-bo-kluea-loop.story: A 131 km loop that starts and ends near Nan, about 2 h 07 of riding. It goes by way of Pua, Doi Phu Kha, Bo Kluea and Santikhiri road. The highest point is about 1,700 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
